text.subtitle: A Library of Greece and Rome
text.description: Pantheon Scroll: a free offline library of the Greek and Roman world — Homer and Virgil, the tragedians and Aristophanes, the lyric poets, Herodotus, Thucydides, Livy and Tacitus, Plutarch's Lives, the orators, and the sciences of antiquity.
